name: Timis
overview: Dive into the heart of Timis, where Fella and Sémou tackle corruption and the issue of oil in Senegal. Facing the formidable Minister Kanté, the Treasury inspector and the journalist must choose: remain silent to survive or risk everything to expose the truth. They will be supported by Matar Lô, the last remaining union force, ready to do anything to resist. A gripping thriller of power struggles, betrayals, and resistance.
